items.source: Return an Advisor wrapping the given advice.
items.translation: 返回一个包装给定建议的Advisor。

items.source: Uses of UnknownAdviceTypeException in org.springframework.aop.framework.adapter
SPI package allowing Spring AOP framework to handle arbitrary advice types.
items.translation: 允许 Spring AOP 框架处理任意通知类型的 SPI 包。

items.source:
Return an array of AOP Alliance MethodInterceptors to allow use of the
given Advisor in an interception-based framework.
items.translation: 返回一个 AOP Alliance MethodInterceptors 数组，以便在基于拦截的框架中使用给定的 Advisor。
